verdict.rationale: Airweave ingests data through source connections that sync automatically in the background (airweave-docs-2), and syncs can be triggered from workflows (airweave-docs-23). Webhooks push notifications when syncs complete, and the docs frame this as an alternative to polling the API (airweave-docs-9, airweave-docs-15), which implies sync status can be checked. Missing for 10: explicit async or batch ingestion APIs, evidence of throughput or scale, a documented status endpoint for background operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
